ideas.pitch: A dual-input CNN that processes both grayscale lunar surface images and sun azimuth metadata to correctly classify craters versus mounds despite variable lighting shadows.
ideas.problem_statement: The Pareidolia Paradox: Classifying 256x256 grayscale lunar surface images into depth (craters/holes) and rise (mounds/hills) categories while accounting for topographic inversion using sun_azimuth_angle.
ideas.title: Azimuth-Aware ResNet for Lunar Topographic Inversion
ideas.why_it_could_win: By explicitly concatenating the sun azimuth angle as a secondary feature vector alongside image embeddings, the model directly solves the core optical illusion problem of topographic inversion, maximizing Balanced Accuracy.

ideas.pitch: An image preprocessing pipeline that simulates or normalizes lighting variations based on sun azimuth before feeding patches into an EfficientNet classifier.
ideas.problem_statement: The Pareidolia Paradox: Classifying 256x256 grayscale lunar surface images into depth (craters/holes) and rise (mounds/hills) categories while accounting for topographic inversion using sun_azimuth_angle.
ideas.title: TopoShadow-Net: Contrastive Shadow Normalization for Lunar Classification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Most teams will pass raw images directly into a standard pretrained model and fail on inverted shadows; this preprocessing approach targets the exact failure mode judges will test against.

ideas.pitch: An XGBoost and CNN hybrid model equipped with Grad-CAM visualization to prove to judges that predictions are based on structural terrain curvature rather than misleading shadow artifacts.

ideas.title: LunarGrad-CAM Explainable Terrain Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Incorporates model explainability to satisfy the evaluation encouragement of focusing on underlying terrain rather than visual shadow patterns, mirroring clinical explainability wins.

ideas.pitch: A multi-modal architecture using a vision backbone for the 256x256 image and a cyclical encoding of the sun azimuth angle fused via fully connected layers for binary classification.

ideas.title: SunAzimuth Meta-Embedding Fusion for Lunar Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Treats sun azimuth as a cyclical continuous feature (sine/cosine transformation) rather than a raw linear variable, capturing the true periodic nature of solar angles.
